wn.name: WaterCraft
wn.numbers: Wixii halkan ku jira waa caawimo xisaab. Injineer biyaha ayaa hubin kasta; tirooyinka ma aha shahaado ama naqshad la ogaaday.
wn.privacy: Shabakaddaadu waxay ku sii jirtaa mashruucan iyo kombiyuutarkan kaliya. Waxba looma diro meel kale.
wn.stopped: Waa la joojiyay hore: liistada waxay ka kooban tahay kaliya wixii la sameeyay.
wn.more: {n} safaf oo dheeraad ah ayaa ku jira CSV-ga.
wn.progress.nodes: Socodka dab-demiska: {done} ka mid ah {n} hidrant
wn.err.nonet: Mashruucan weli shabakad biyo ma leh. Marka hore isticmaal qalabka Tuubooyinka biyaha si aad u sawirto isku-xidhka, kaydka iyo tuubooyinka.
wn.err.noloads: Marka hore ku dhaji ugu yaraan hal xariiq oo baahi ah.
wn.err.trace_node: Dooro kaydka ama tangiga uu raadintu ka bilaabanto.
wn.err.not_configured: WaterCraft ma gaari karin xalinta biyaha. Bogga dib u cusboonaysii.
wn.dem.help: Macmiil kasta hal xariiq: aqoonsi, x, y, nooc, tiro. Nooca waa mid ka mid ah {kinds}, ama flow haddii aad socod la qoray. Tirada waa unug (guri), balaadhka (acre, ama hektar marka metric la isticmaalo) ama socod. Mid kasta waxa loo geeyaa isku-xidhka ugu dhow.
wn.dem.share: Wadaag baahi ka dhexeeya isku-xidhka ku dhow ilaa 300 ft (90 m)
wn.pat.keep: Qaabka ha ahaado sida uu yahay
wn.dem.starting: Isticmaalka guri kasta ama acre kasta waa qiime bilow, ma aha heer caadi ah. Ka beddel qiimayaasha naqshadeynta ee shirkadda biyaha kahor intaadan natiijada isku halayn.
wn.dem.result: Wadarta {total} {u} waxa ku jira {n} isku-xidhka; {bad} xariiq lama geyn karin.
wn.dem.applied: Baahiyaha waa lagu qoray tuubooyinka biyaha. Ka noqo ayaa dib u qaadaya.
wn.fire.help: Hidrant kasta (ama isku-xidhka kasta haddii aan la calaamadin): socodka uu bixin karo intii cadaadisku hadhaagga ku hayn lahaa, oo lagu helo isla xalinta daaqadda Tuubooyinka biyaha.
wn.fire.system: Meel kasta oo nidaamka ku jira (adag)
wn.fire.mult: Isku-dhufashada baahida (1 = baahida sida la sawiray; isticmaal caamilka maalinta ugu badan)
wn.fire.result: {pass} ka mid ah ayaa buuxinaya {needed} {q} ee {res} {p}; {fail} way ku yaraadaan.
wn.limit.base: cadaadis hoose ka hor inta aan biyo la qaadin
wn.limit.cap: ka badan intii raadintu isku dayday
wn.crit.help: Mid kasta oo tuubo ah wakhti-wakhti ka saara adeegga, oo mar kale xisaabi: inta baahi la gooyo iyo isku-xidhka cadaadiskoodu ka hooseeyo heerka ugu yar. Haddii fiilboollaha (valve) tuubooyinka lagu dhejiyay, qayb fiilboollaha leh oo dhan ayaa la ka saari karaa.
wn.crit.segment: hal qayb oo fiilboollaha leh mar
wn.crit.result: {n} joojin ayaa la isku dayay; {cut} ka mid ah ayaa macmiil qaarkood ka gooyay.
wn.q.help: Biyaha ayuu ku raacaa socodka 24 saac: da'daada, inta klooriin ka hadhay, ama meesha ay ka timid. Waxay isticmaashaa qaabka baahida iyo heerarka tangiyada ee Tuubooyinka biyaha.
wn.q.minc: Hadhaaga ugu yar ee la doonayo (mg/L)
wn.q.maxage: Biyaha ugu da'da weyn ee la doonayo (saacadood)
wn.q.result: {n} isku-xidhka ka baxsan xadka aad dejisay.
wn.q.limits: Burburka koowaad oo kaliya; tangi waa hal isku-dhafan oo mugga ah, weli saldhig kor-u-qaade ma jiro. Si aad u akhrisid maalinta ugu dambeysa, si dheer u socodsii ilaa qaabku ku celcelinayo.
wn.sec.sizing: Cabbirrada tuubada iyo dib u habeynta
wn.pc.help: Wuxuu akhrinayaa barcelooyinka lagu sawiray mashruucan. Barcel kasta wuxuu noqonayaa hal macmiil dhexdiisa; isticmaalkiisu wuxuu go'aaminayaa baahida. Sheeg barcel kasta waxa loo isticmaalo, mid mid sadar kasta: aqoonsi = isticmaal (aqoonsiyada iyo magacyada waxa ku jira liiska barcelooyinka), ama dooro hal isticmaal oo loo gaarsiinayo inta kale.
wn.pc.perunit: Aagga hal guri (cutubyada aagga mashruuca; 0 = hal guri barcel kasta)
wn.pc.none: Mashruucan weli barcel ma leh. Marka hore ku sawir ama ku soo degso CivilCraft.
wn.pc.result: {n} barcelood ayaa noqonaya macmiil, wadarta {total} {u}. {skipped} ayaa laga reebay.
wn.sc.help: Xaalad kasta waa magac iyo isbeddel shabakadda ah. Sadarrada: close P12, open P12, demand x1.5, demand J5 120, diameter P3 16, c P4 80, pump P1 off, tank T1 level 130, reservoir R1 head 820, fire J9 1000. Xaaladda ugu horreysa waa saldhigga kuwa kale lagu barbardhigayo.
wn.sc.pdd: Cadaadisku go'aamiyo waxa la geeyo (socod yaraan)
wn.sc.none: Marka hore qor ugu yaraan hal xaalad.
wn.sc.lowest: Laba iyo tobnaan isgoyn oo ugu cadaadis hooseeya xaalad kasta:
wn.sc.m.lowNodes: Isgoyn ka hooseeya inta ugu yar
wn.sc.m.highNodes: Isgoyn ka sarreeya inta ugu badan
wn.pd.help: Socod caadi ah wuxuu geeyaa baahi kasta cadaadis kasta. Halkan isgoyn kasta wuxuu geeyaa oo keliya waxa cadaadiisu oggol yahay: waxba cadaadiska ugu hooseeya ama ka hooseeya, dhammaan cadaadiska buuxa ama ka sarreeya. Ku dar isgoynno daadinaya (node, coefficient) iyo daadin tuubooyinka dhexdooda haddii aad yaqaanto.
wn.pd.pmin: Cadaadiska ka hooseeya wax lama geeyo ({p})
wn.pd.exp: Tirada u dhexaysa labadooda (0.5 caadi ah)
wn.pd.emitters: Isgoynno daadinaya: node, coefficient (socod halkii cadaadis^0.5)
wn.pd.leakc: Daadin tuubooyinka dhexdooda: socod halkii 1000 cutub dherer iyo 1 cutub cadaadis (0 = ma jiro)
wn.pd.result: La doonay {req} {u}, la geeyay {del}, yaraan {def}. Daadintu waxay qaadataa {leak} {u}.
wn.pd.noconv: Xisaabtu ma dhammaan: akhriska tirooyinka si taxaddar leh u akhri.
wn.pd.allserved: Isgoyn kasta wuxuu helaa waxa uu codsaday.
wn.en.help: Xeerarka xakameynta, mid mid sadar kasta, erayada caadiga ah: LINK P1 CLOSED IF NODE T1 ABOVE 140, LINK P1 OPEN IF NODE T1 BELOW 110, LINK P1 OPEN AT TIME 6, LINK P1 CLOSED AT CLOCKTIME 22. Faalfallada, mid mid sadar: aqoonsi, tuubo, FCV ama PSV, dejin (socod ama cadaadis). Socodsiintu waxay sheegaysaa heerarka tankiyada, dhacdooyinka xeerarka iyo kharashka tamarta bam kasta.
wn.en.valves: Faalfallada (aqoonsi, tuubo, FCV ama PSV, dejin {q} ama {p})
wn.en.tariff: Qiimaha halkii saac maalinta (dhufasho, 24 tiro; bannaan = mid isku mid ah)
wn.en.problems: {n} dhacdo oo tanki ah (buuxa ama madhan): tankiga waxaa lagu hayey xadkiisa.
wn.em.help: Waxa dhaca iyo intee le'eg uu socdo marka wax khaldamo. Jebinta tuubo waxay tuubada ka saartaa adeegga (faalfallada ku wareegsan haddii la sawiray); dab wuxuu biyo ka jiidaa hydrant; kala go'ida korontada wuxuu joojiyaa bamadda (ka tag sanduuqa bamka madhan si ay dhammaantood u noqdaan).
wn.em.result: Ugu xumaanta ka go'ay: {cut} {u} isgoyn {n} ah. Cadaadiska ugu hooseeya {minp} {p}. Kii ugu horreeyay ee ka hooseeya inta ugu yar: {first}.
wn.em.hourslow: Saacadaha ka hooseeya inta ugu yar
wn.em.nolow: Isgoyn ma hoos galo inta ugu yar.
wn.cal.help: Akhriska goobta, mid mid sadar: cadaadis ama socod, isgoynta ama tuubada, qiimaha ({p} ama {q}), iyo ikhtiyaar ahaan tirada baahida waqtigaas. Kooxaha tuubooyinka oo adkaanshahoodu wada dhaqdhaqaaqo, mid mid sadar: magac: P1 P2 P3 (ma jiro = dhammaan tuubooyinka wada). Fadlan akhris ka badan kooxaha.
wn.cal.dm: Sidoo kale hal isu-dhigid ku habee baahi kasta
wn.cal.result: Qaladka ka hor {a}, ka dib {b} (1 waxay la mid tahay sida akhriska laftiisu u saxan yahay).
wn.cal.applied: Adkaanshaha waa ku jira xariiqyada biyaha; Ka noqo ayaa dib u celinaysa.
wn.sz.help: Sii cabbirrada aad iibsan kartid ({d}, yar ilaa weyn, kala soocan koomo) iyo qiimaha halkii cutub dherer mid kasta (cabbir = qiime, mid mid sadar). Socodku wuxuu kor u qaadaa tuubooyinka ugu faa'iidada badan lacagta ilaa isgoyn kasta uu cadaadiska gaadho oo tuubo kasta aanu dhakhsaha badnayn, kadibna wuxuu dib u qaadaa cabbir kasta oo aan loo baahnayn. Tuubooyinka lama yareeyo.
wn.sz.no: Cabbirrada la siiyay xadka ma gaadhi karaan ({n} tuubo la isku dayay, wadarta {cost}). Ku dar cabbir weyn.
wn.sz.applied: Cabbirradu waa ku jiraan xariiqyada biyaha; Ka noqo ayaa dib u celinaysa.
wn.rh.help: Dib u habayn: tuubooyinka duugga ah waxay leeyihiin C hoose. Magacyada ikhtiyaarka (magac, C cusub, qiimaha halkii cutub dherer, mid mid sadar) iyo miisaaniyad sheeg; socodku wuxuu doortaa tuubooyinka ugu kordhiya cadaadiska lacag kasta. Cadaadiska ugu yar iyo xawaaraha kor ku xusan ayaa khuseeya.
wn.rh.no: Miisaaniyadda ama ikhtiyaarrada xadka ma gaadhayaan: {n} tuubo la doortay, {cost} la kharash gareeyay.
